The numerator lookback window ({MY-10}-01-01 to {MY}-12-31) is derived from the age range and the 'one-time' wording, not stated in the text; it requires human review. A screen done before age 65 would not count under this window.
The rule uses the ever_smoker concept, so it relies on structured smoking history. Patients with missing or unrecorded smoking status will not enter the denominator.
The rule has no repeat-screening logic. The text says the screening is 1-time and gives no follow-up intervals for abnormal results.
